meta.notes: Orders come from view_reports.oms_sales_union, the table the business uses for its own sales reporting. Filters match the canonical queries exactly: date window only, no status or validity filters, no deduplication (SUM(sales) on this table agrees with per-order aggregation, so there is no row duplication to remove). METRICS_PERIOD_ANCHOR=month makes the window the last 6 COMPLETE calendar months, reproducing `date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-08-31'`. aovMethod is 'total_over_orders' -> SUM(sales)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), per the canonical AOV query. Note this table carries ~1.75 rows per order, so AVG(sales) would give the average LINE ITEM value instead and read 35-55% lower; it is still returned as supporting.averageRowValue. The previous mapping against view_reports.oms_sales_raw_optimized is kept as config/schema.mapping.oms-raw.json.
